title: Supplement: Decision diagrams: CNF2BDD-Bench MCC family, September 2026
about: September 2026 development snapshot and five BDD packages on 231 formulas, ten minutes per instance. All 231 formulas of the CNF2BDD-Bench MCC family; published inputs and static MINCE orders for the packages.

title: Supplement: Decision diagrams: Original MCC cohort, September 2026
about: September 2026 development snapshot and five BDD packages on 635 formulas, ten minutes per instance. A selected cohort of 635 original competition CNFs, not the full MCC corpus; static FORCE orders for the packages.

title: Supplement: logic circuits, MCC 2025–2026
about: tididi-cnf and four d-DNNF compilers, two minutes per instance; an instance is solved when the compiler wrote its circuit in time and the circuit's model count, checked independently, was right.

title: Supplement: model counters, MCC 2025–2026
about: tididi-cnf and the exact counters entered in the 2026 competition, two minutes per instance; an instance is solved when the solver printed its count in time.
